options.description: Questions from sessions still running stay in effect and can hold a merge. Only leftovers from ended or older sessions stop counting. Recommended: Your words only describe old questions from other merge requests not blocking a merge. Limiting the change to ended or older sessions is the narrowest reading that still fixes that.
